questions.text: Five years ago from now, Aman was 6 times as old as Chaman. After 5 years from now, he will be 2 times as old as Chaman will then be. The present age of Aman (in years) is: Ans A). 20 B). 19 C). 12 D). 16 Correct Answer: A

A school has three classes: X, Y and Z. Class X has 25 students with an average score of 70, Class Y has 35 students with an average score of 80, and Class Z has M students with an average score of 90. If the average score of all students is 80, find the value of M. Ans A). 15 B). 20 C). 10 D). 25 Correct Answer: D
